description: Swap things already built, in place: walls or frames, upgrade or tidy cable, pipe and chute networks. Reports first; confirm: true does it.

options.id: frame, pipe, chute: An id, a list, a ref ('r3'), or "looking_at". cable: Pieces (up to 4096). Any what that takes an id takes a list: one row per id, {results: [{index, ok, reference_id, ...} or {index, ok, reference_id, error}], count, success_count, error_count}; a bad id is a row with error.
options.materials: Holder(s) that pay, in order; ids or "player".
options.confirm: true acts; left out, it reports.
options.into: wall: The new wall prefab. frame: The new frame prefab; default each frame's own (finishes it). cable: Upgrade to this grade (heavy was today's default). One of into or tidy is required. pipe: insulated (today's default), or repair: burst pieces become new. One of into or tidy is required.
options.prefab: wall: Only pieces of these prefabs; the others are kept. frame: Only pieces of these prefabs.
options.network: A network: its id, a piece or device on it, or {id, port}.
options.tidy: cable: Tidy operations, alone or together; true is [simplify_junctions], today's default. pipe: Tidy operations; true is [simplify_junctions], today's default.
options.box: Every chute piece in the box (at most a 32 m cube).
options.riding: A piece holding an item: skip it, or refuse the run. Default skip.
